meta.title: Lumen · Wallpaper
meta.description: Procedural wallpapers with a rotation scheduler: generated designs, changing on an interval, the hour, or daily
section.label: Wallpaper
group.builtin.hint: Generated from parameters — no image assets
group.splash.hint: Covers the interface while it starts, then hands it over
custom.local.hint: Drop or choose — multiple allowed. Auto-resized and compressed, long edge up to 2560px
splash.local.hint: A picture is painted full-bleed; a clip plays. One file — you choose where it goes afterwards
splash.oneAtATime: A splash takes one file at a time
splash.stored: Set as the splash ({kb}KB). A splash is injected when DSH starts, so a full restart of DSH is what will show it
splash.storedBoth: Set as both the wallpaper and the splash ({kb}KB). The wallpaper is live now; the splash shows after a full restart of DSH
splash.wallpaperFailed: The splash is set ({kb}KB), but the wallpaper half did not take. The splash shows after a full restart of DSH
splash.cleared: Splash cleared, and its file removed
splash.nothingToClear: There was no splash to clear
splash.unknown: The host route is unavailable, so the splash state cannot be read
splash.error.noHost: No host route — a splash needs the host's own file
splash.error.unsupported: PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF / AVIF pictures and MP4 / WebM / OGG clips only
splash.error.tooLarge: That file is too large — the host refused the upload
splash.error.network: The upload did not complete — check the connection and retry
rotation.enable.hint: Walk the playlist on a schedule
rotation.empty: The playlist is empty — add a few wallpapers first
rotation.seeded: Added {n} built-in wallpapers and started rotating. Your previous wallpaper is kept — turn rotation off to get it back
rotation.session.hint: Change each time you return to the page
rotation.order.hint.shuffle: No repeats until the list is exhausted
rotation.order.hint.random: Any entry except the previous one
rotation.session.noClock: Driven by page visibility — no fixed time
rotation.missed: Missed {n} while asleep — skipped, advanced once
appearance.opacity.hint: Higher shows more of the wallpaper; the readability floor below still caps it
appearance.raised: Thickened to keep text readable: about {n}% of the wallpaper shows
appearance.autoDim.hint: Busier pictures get a heavier wash
appearance.readability.hint: Solves the wash floor for WCAG AA so text cannot fail
appearance.position.hint: Where the subject sits — move it clear of the sidebar
appearance.tuning.hint: Hue and softness apply to generated wallpapers; grain applies to all (half strength on photos)
status.washBlocked: The canvas was not made translucent, so the shell is covering the wallpaper. This line appears when the theme channel is unavailable
status.noStorage: localStorage unavailable — nothing will survive a reload
custom.imported: Imported {n} — the first is on screen, the rest are in the playlist
custom.importCapped: Imported {n}; the playlist is full ({cap} limit)
error.notImage: That is not an image file
error.tooLarge: That image is too large (32MB limit)
error.stillTooLarge: Still too large after compression — try another
